title: Player opens the phone hub
description: The /me hub is the compact personal home: check in or out, Settings, Payment, Logout, and Full app.

steps.title: Players home
steps.body: On a wide screen you land on the roster. The phone hub is always at /me, and Full app returns here.

steps.title: Open /me
steps.body: On a compact phone the Me control returns to this hub. This walkthrough opens /me directly so the tiles are visible at tutorial size.

steps.title: Phone hub
steps.body: Check in or out from the large tile, then use Settings, Payment, Logout, or Full app.
